text: Decentralized power regulation has been a conscious goal for centuries, but only now has technology improved enough to account for good and bad behavior on a near infinitesimal scale and to reward and punish fairly.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Eight Institutions for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782205
